item.description:
Local installation and signed automatic application updates.
- Sparkle 2.10.1 checks for app updates on launch and daily while the app runs. - Updates download in the background and install on quit when authorization is not required. A native "Check for App Updates…" menu item is also available. - The update feed and archives are Ed25519 signed. Archives are verified before extraction; system profiling is disabled. - The UI and application remain Rust + Iced. Sparkle is a bundled native framework. - Local bundle builds and public release packaging verify nested signatures. - Public packaging now requires Developer ID and notarization by default; non-notarized releases require the explicit `--preview` option.
**Apple Silicon, macOS 13+, Homebrew required.**
This release remains an **ad-hoc signed, non-notarized preview**. A new download may require the per-app first-launch approval described in [Apple's instructions](https://support.apple.com/102445). Update signatures protect Sparkle updates; they do not constitute Apple notarization.
Version 0.1.0 does not contain an updater and needs a one-time update to this version. Future releases published to the signed appcast can update in-app.
